nodes.label: build_model
nodes.desc: Meta-arch registry lookup: resolves cfg.MODEL.META_ARCHITECTURE to a class and calls its from_config.

nodes.label: GeneralizedRCNN
nodes.desc: The default meta-architecture holding backbone, proposal generator and ROI heads as plain submodules.

nodes.label: from_config
nodes.desc: Builds the three child components from the config and hands them to the constructor as kwargs.

nodes.label: forward
nodes.desc: Training path: preprocess images, run backbone, get proposals and ROI losses, merge into one loss dict.

nodes.label: inference
nodes.desc: Eval path: backbone, RPN proposals, ROI decoding, optional postprocess back to original resolution.

nodes.label: preprocess_image
nodes.desc: Normalizes the input tensor with PIXEL_MEAN/PIXEL_STD buffers on the model's device.

nodes.label: _postprocess
nodes.desc: Scales predicted boxes from resized input coordinates back to the original image size.

nodes.label: build_backbone
nodes.desc: Builds the configured backbone and optionally wraps it with FPN from cfg.MODEL.FPN.IN_FEATURES.

nodes.label: ResNet
nodes.desc: Backbone subclass implementing stem, four stages, freeze_at logic and output_shape mapping.

nodes.label: make_stage
nodes.desc: Static helper stacking bottleneck or basic blocks while threading in_channels to out_channels.

nodes.label: build_resnet_backbone
nodes.desc: The default BACKBONE.NAME builder mapping RESNETS.DEPTH like 50 or 101 to stem and stage specs.

nodes.label: FPN
nodes.desc: Adds 1x1 lateral convs and top-down upsampling over chosen in_features, outputting FUSE_TYPE-merged pyramid.

nodes.label: build_proposal_generator
nodes.desc: Registry factory resolving cfg.MODEL.PROPOSAL_GENERATOR.NAME, default RPN.

nodes.label: RPN
nodes.desc: Applies the RPN head per feature level, anchors, objectness and box deltas, then proposal selection.

nodes.label: StandardRPNHead
nodes.desc: Stacked 3x3 conv followed by 1x1 objectness and box-delta heads shared across levels.

nodes.label: find_top_rpn_proposals
nodes.desc: Decodes deltas, clips boxes, removes small and duplicate boxes via NMS, keeps PRE/POST_NMS_TOPK.

nodes.label: DefaultAnchorGenerator
nodes.desc: Buffers of cell anchors expanded over feature-map grids, respecting sizes, ratios, angles and offset.

nodes.label: build_roi_heads
nodes.desc: Registry factory for cfg.MODEL.ROI_HEADS.NAME, e.g. Res5ROIHeads or StandardROIHeads.

nodes.label: StandardROIHeads
nodes.desc: Sampler, box pooler and predictor plus optional mask and keypoint branches; defines forward/losses.

nodes.label: FastRCNNOutputLayers
nodes.desc: Box classifier head: class scores, box regression, smooth-L1 or focal losses, NMS inference.

nodes.label: MaskRCNNConvUpsampleHead
nodes.desc: Per-ROI 28x28 mask branch: stacked 3x3 convs with 2x upsampling, per-class binary masks.

nodes.label: DefaultPredictor
nodes.desc: Wraps build_model plus DetectionCheckpointer and ResizeShortestEdge for one-image inference.

nodes.label: DefaultTrainer
nodes.desc: Sets up optimizer, loaders, hooks and checkpointer; classmethod test() runs COCO evaluation.

nodes.label: TrainerBase
nodes.desc: Hook registry, before/after step events and train() loop driving the run of registered hooks.

nodes.label: launch
nodes.desc: Spawns NUM_GPUS processes or submits a Slurm job, initializes distributed groups, then calls main.

nodes.label: CfgNode defaults
nodes.desc: The _C yacs tree: MODEL, INPUT, DATASETS, SOLVER, TEST sections merged with user yaml overrides.

nodes.label: build_detection_train_loader
nodes.desc: Serialization-safe infinite training loader with mapper, sampler, and aspect-ratio grouping collator.

nodes.label: build_detection_test_loader
nodes.desc: Deterministic sequential loader for evaluation datasets registered in the DatasetCatalog.

nodes.label: DetectionCheckpointer
nodes.desc: Extends Checkpointer with model-compatibility fixes and conversion of Detectron/Caffe2 weights.
